svg.aria-label: The DABstep loop as a ring: the ten-task dev split feeds a run of the champion, every task is traced to a JSON file with its cost and turns, the vendored scorer grades each answer, one Sonnet 5 optimiser session reads every failure and both champion surfaces, writes only the next version's prompt and helper and files a diagnosis, the challenger runs on the same ten, a one-sided exact McNemar test on the paired flips promotes at p below 0.05 or holds, the registry records the verdict either way, CI re-scores the champion and a smoke test checks the deployed image, and a read-only reflection pass records what the next optimiser should know. Off the ring sit the single model choke point and the write guard with its checksum.

g.title: 01 · the split — data/tasks/dev.jsonl holds the ten tasks with gold; data/tasks/all.jsonl holds the 450 without, locked behind a confirmation and never scored in this build; test_dev_split_has_ten_gold_and_all_has_none pins both counts

02 · run — eval/runner.py: one agent version on one split at three workers behind an asyncio semaphore; writes runs/<id>/run.json, results.jsonl, traces/ and the submission file; run folders are immutable once scored

03 · trace — runs/<id>/traces/<task>.json: turns, input and output tokens, cost, duration, terminal reason and final text for every task; tracking/mlflow_log.py indexes the run with agent, fingerprint, model and code SHA
04 · score — eval/scorer.py vendored verbatim from the benchmark space and excluded from ruff and mypy; exact match per task, then easy and hard counts

05 · optimise — loop/optimiser.py: one ClaudeSDKClient session on claude-sonnet-5 at high effort, up to 120 turns, shown both champion surfaces, every failed task with its gold and a condensed trace, the ledger history and any held challenger as a starting point; cycle 1 took 40 turns and 3.85 M input tokens, cycle 2 took 27 and 2.05 M

06 · write v(N+1) — the session may write agents/v(N+1)/system.md and helper.py only; agent.yaml must be byte-identical; it must verify helper changes against the gold in-session and finish with diagnosis.json carrying a per-edit change log
07 · register — tracking/registry.py: the challenger is registered with its fingerprint and run id; loop/registry.json keeps an append-only history of every promote and register event

08 · gate — eval/compare.py: the challenger runs on the same ten, then a one-sided exact McNemar test on the paired flips, alpha 0.05; five fixes and no break is the smallest result that clears it; the verdict carries fixed, broken and p and lands on loop/ledger.jsonl whether it promotes or holds

09 · deploy — tracking/gate.py re-scores the champion's committed results in CI and checks its fingerprint against the registry; a green main deploys by OIDC to ECR and App Runner, and demo_smoke.sh asserts demo mode, a registered champion, 450 tasks and a declined question

10 · reflect — loop/reflect.py: a read-only Sonnet pass over the champion's traces, up to 40 turns, that records a summary, consistency notes, open gaps and sibling-template groups on the ledger; cycle 2's pass found why v1 broke task 1871 before the next optimiser ran
11 · next cycle — the promoted challenger is the champion; a held challenger stays on the ledger and is offered to the next optimiser as a starting point, not a rejected one

llm.py — the single model choke point: haiku for the agent under test, sonnet for the optimiser and reflection; require_live() refuses to build a model under DEMO_MODE=1, and a subscription session has the API key stripped from its environment

the write guard — a PreToolUse hook denies any Write, Edit or MultiEdit outside agents/v(N+1)/ and any edit to agent.yaml; a checksum over ten guarded paths is compared after the session and any change voids the cycle
